details.sdg_goals_and_climate_mechanism_taught: The Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) combine economic, social and environmental pillars—livelihoods, well-being and natural systems—with ambitions for 2030. Examples are SDG 1, No Poverty; 2, Zero Hunger; 3, Good Health and Well-being; 4, Quality Education; 5, Gender Equality; 6, Clean Water and Sanitation; 8, Decent Work and Economic Growth; 12, Responsible Consumption and Production; and 13, Climate Action. Climate-related drought and flooding threaten crops, water and infrastructure, undermining livelihoods and development gains. Suitable adaptation reduces vulnerability, while reducing emissions limits further warming and protects future needs. A particular local event cannot be attributed to climate change merely because it occurred.
sdg_three_mark_demand_and_guidance: Context, 1 mark: a feasible reuse response addressing the offcuts and small bags.
Reason, 1 mark: connect that response to reduced new-material use or avoidable waste; do not count the same benefit twice.
Goal, 1 mark: identify SDG 12 or its title, Responsible Consumption and Production. No paid-work assumption or second goal is required.
Original indicative practice guidance; not an official mark scheme.
